evidence.pali: ‘‘Katamācāvuso, sammādiṭṭhi? Yaṃ kho, āvuso, dukkhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ, ayaṃ vuccatāvuso – ‘sammādiṭṭhi’’’.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 贤友，云何为正见？贤友，于苦之智，于苦集之智，于苦灭之智，于导向苦灭之道之智，贤友，此谓‘正见’。
evidence.english: “And what, friends, is Right View? Whatever knowledge there is, friends, in regard to suffering, in regard to the origin of suffering, in regard to the cessation of suffering, and in regard to the path of practice leading to the cessation of suffering—this, friends, is called Right View.”

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Tatiyasaccaṃ pana yasmā ‘ni’saddo abhāvaṃ ‘rodha’ saddo ca cārakaṃ dīpeti, tasmā abhāvo ettha saṃsāracārakasaṅkhātassa dukkharodhassa sabbagatisuññattā, samadhigate vā tasmiṃ saṃsāracārakasaṅkhātassa dukkharodhassa abhāvo hoti tappaṭipakkhattātipi dukkhanirodha nti vuccati, dukkhassa vā anuppādanirodhapaccayattā dukkhanirodhanti. Catutthasaccaṃ pana yasmā etaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ gacchati ārammaṇavasena tadabhimukhībhūtattā, paṭipadā ca hoti dukkhanirodhappattiyā, tasmā dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti vuccati.
entries.chinese_simplified: 至于第三圣谛，因“ni”一词表示“无”，“rodha”一词表示“牢狱”，是故，于此（灭谛）中，被称为轮回牢狱的苦之牢狱，于一切趣中皆空而无；或已证得彼时，被称为轮回牢狱的苦之牢狱即不存在，因其与彼（苦）对立之故，亦称为“苦灭”(dukkhanirodha)；或因其是苦不生与息灭之缘，故称“苦灭”。至于第四圣谛，因其朝向此苦灭，以之为所缘而趣向之，且是到达苦灭之道，是故被称为“导向苦灭之道”(dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā)。
entries.english: As for the third truth, since the word 'ni' indicates absence and the word 'rodha' indicates confinement, therefore, here, there is an absence of the confinement of suffering, which is designated as the prison of saṃsāra, due to its being void of all destinations. Or, when that cessation is attained, there is an absence of the confinement of suffering, which is designated as the prison of saṃsāra, because it is its opposite. Thus, it is called 'dukkhanirodha' (the cessation of suffering). Or, because it is the condition for the non-arising and cessation of suffering, it is called 'dukkhanirodha'. As for the fourth truth, since this path approaches the cessation of suffering by way of object, because it is directed towards it, and it is the path for the attainment of the cessation of suffering, therefore it is called 'the path leading to the cessation of suffering'.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: ‘Ariyasaccesu yaṃ ñāṇaṃ tassa kiccato’ ti saccañāṇakiccatopi vinicchayo veditabboti attho. Duvidhañhi saccañāṇaṃ – anubodhañāṇañca paṭivedhañāṇañca. Tattha anubodhañāṇaṃ lokiyaṃ anussavādivasena nirodhe magge ca pavattati. Paṭivedhañāṇaṃ lokuttaraṃ nirodhārammaṇaṃ katvā kiccato cattāripi saccāni paṭivijjhati. Yathāha – ‘‘yo, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ passati dukkhasamudayampi so passati, dukkhanirodhampi passati, dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadampi passatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.1100) sabbaṃ vattabbaṃ. Yaṃ panetaṃ lokiyaṃ, tattha dukkhañāṇaṃ pariyuṭṭhānābhibhavanavasena pavattamānaṃ sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ nivatteti, samudayañāṇaṃ ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ, nirodhañāṇaṃ sassatadiṭṭhiṃ, maggañāṇaṃ akiriyadiṭṭhiṃ; dukkhañāṇaṃ vā dhuvasubhasukhattabhāvarahitesu khandhesu dhuvasubhasukhattabhāvasaññāsaṅkhātaṃ phale vippaṭipattiṃ, samudayañāṇaṃ issarappadhānakālasabhāvādīhi loko pavattatīti akāraṇe kāraṇābhimānappavattaṃ hetumhi vippaṭipattiṃ, nirodhañāṇaṃ arūpalokalokathūpikādīsu apavaggaggāhabhūtaṃ nirodhe vippaṭipattiṃ, maggañāṇaṃ kāmasukhallikaattakilamathānuyogappabhede avisuddhimagge visuddhimaggaggāhavasena pavattaṃ upāye vippaṭipattiṃ nivatteti. Tenetaṃ vuccati –
entries.chinese_simplified: “‘于圣谛中，智由其作用而知’，此义为，亦应知依谛智之作用所作的抉择。谛智有二：随觉智(anubodhañāṇa)与通达智(paṭivedhañāṇa)。其中，随觉智为世间智，依听闻等而于灭与道中转起。通达智为出世间智，以灭为所缘，从作用上通达四谛。如（世尊）所说：‘诸比丘，见苦者，亦见苦集，见苦灭，亦见导向苦灭之道。’（《相应部》5.1100）等皆应宣说。至于此世间智，苦智以镇伏缠而转起，断除有身见(sakkāyadiṭṭhi)；集智断除断见(ucchedadiṭṭhi)；灭智断除常见(sassatadiṭṭhi)；道智断除无作见(akiriyadiṭṭhi)。或，苦智于远离常、净、乐、我性的诸蕴中，断除于果上的颠倒，即（于其中）起常、净、乐、我之想；集智断除于因上的颠倒，即认为世界由自在天(issara)、原质(padhāna)、时(kāla)、自性(sabhāva)等而转起，于非因中起因慢；灭智断除于灭上的颠倒，即于无色界、世界顶(lokathūpikā)等处执为解脱；道智断除于方便上的颠倒，即于欲乐享受与自我折磨等非清净道中执为清净道。是故说——
entries.english: As to 'from the function of the knowledge regarding the Noble Truths,' this means that the discernment should be understood also from the function of the knowledge of the truths. For the knowledge of the truths is twofold: knowledge through understanding and knowledge through penetration. Here, knowledge through understanding is mundane and operates in dependence on hearsay, etc., regarding cessation and the path. Knowledge through penetration is supramundane; taking cessation as its object, by its function it penetrates all four truths. As it is said: 'Bhikkhus, whoever sees suffering also sees the origin of suffering, the cessation of suffering, and the path leading to the cessation of suffering' (SN 5.1100), and so on. As for this mundane knowledge: the knowledge of suffering, operating by way of overcoming obsession, averts the view of self; the knowledge of origin averts the view of annihilation; the knowledge of cessation averts the view of eternalism; the knowledge of the path averts the view of non-action. Alternatively, the knowledge of suffering averts the misconception regarding the fruit, which is the perception of permanence, beauty, pleasure, and self in the aggregates devoid of permanence, beauty, pleasure, and self; the knowledge of origin averts the misconception regarding the cause, which is the assumption of a cause where there is none, proceeding with the notion that the world arises through a creator, primordial matter, time, or nature, etc.; the knowledge of cessation averts the misconception regarding cessation, which is the grasping of the formless realms, the peak of the world, etc., as liberation; the knowledge of the path averts the misconception regarding the means, which proceeds by grasping an impure path—differentiated as indulgence in sensual pleasures or self-mortification—as the pure path. Therefore, it is said—

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ānanda, katamaṃ nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā – yo dūratova sukhumena tālacchiggaḷena asanaṃ atipāteyya poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ, yo vā sattadhā bhinnassa vālassa koṭiyā koṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyā’’ti? ‘‘Etadeva, bhante, dukkaratarañceva durabhisambhavatarañca – yo sattadhā bhinnassa vālassa koṭiyā koṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyā’’ti. ‘‘Tato kho te, ānanda, duppaṭivijjhataraṃ paṭivijjhanti ye idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhanti…pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhantī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.1115).
entries.chinese_simplified: “阿难，你怎么想？哪一样更难做到，更难成就呢？是从远处用箭射穿棕榈树的细孔，箭箭相续，无有错失呢？还是将一根毛发劈为七份后，用另一根毛发的尖端去刺透七分之一毛发的尖端呢？”“世尊，这确实更难做到，更难成就——用另一根毛发的尖端去刺透七分之一毛发的尖端。”“阿难，那些如实了知‘这是苦’……乃至如实了知‘这是导向苦灭之道’的人，他们所通达的，比那更难通达。”
entries.english: “What do you think, Ānanda, which is more difficult and harder to accomplish: to shoot arrows from afar through a tiny keyhole, point after point without missing, or to pierce the tip of a hair split sevenfold with another tip?” “This, venerable sir, is more difficult and harder to accomplish—to pierce the tip of a hair split sevenfold with another tip.” “Ānanda, those who penetrate as it really is: ‘This is suffering’ [...] ‘This is the path leading to the cessation of suffering’—they penetrate something even harder to penetrate than that.” (Saṃ. Ni. 5.1115)

entries.pali: Durabhisambhavatara nti abhisambhavituṃ sādhetuṃ asakkuṇeyyataraṃ, sattivighātena duradhigamanti attho. Bādhakapabhavasantiniyyānalakkhaṇehi vavatthānaṃ salakkhaṇavavatthānaṃ . Duravagāhatthena gambhīrattā ti oḷārikā dukkhasamudayā. Tiracchānagatānampi hi dukkhaṃ āhārādīsu ca abhilāso pākaṭo, pīḷanādiāyūhanādivasena pana ‘‘idaṃ dukkhaṃ, idamassa kāraṇa’’nti yāthāvato ogāhituṃ asakkuṇeyyattā gambhīrā, saṇhasukhumadhammattā nirodhamaggā sabhāvato eva gambhīrattā duravagāhā, teneva uppanne magge natthi nirodhamaggānaṃ yāthāvato anavagāhoti. Nibbānampi maggena adhigantabbattā tassa phalanti apadissatīti āha ‘‘phalāpadesato’’ ti. Vuttañhi ‘‘dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ atthapaṭisambhidā’’ti (vibha. 719). Maggopi nirodhassa sampāpakabhāvato hetūti apadissatīti āha ‘‘hetuapadesato’’ ti. Vuttampi cetaṃ ‘‘dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ dhammapaṭisambhidā’’ti (vibha. 719). Iti vijaññā ti iti -saddena vijānanakkamaṃ dasseti. Evaṃ pakārehī ti evaṃ -saddena vijānanakāraṇabhūte naye.
entries.chinese_simplified: 更难证得者，义为更难克服、更难成就；因能力有碍而难通达。以逼迫、生起、寂静、出离等相而确立，即是确立自相。因其难测，故为甚深。粗显者为苦与集。诚然，即使对畜生而言，其苦及对食物等的欲求亦甚明显；但因无法如实地从逼迫、积集等方面通达‘此是苦，此是其因’，故（苦与集）是甚深的。灭与道，因其法体微细精妙，自性本已甚深，故难通达。正因如此，当道生起时，对灭与道的不通达便不存在了。涅槃也因须由道而证得，是道之果，故说为‘以果为名’。如言：‘于苦灭之智是义无碍解。’道也因能令达至灭，是灭之因，故说为‘以因为名’。如言：‘于导向苦灭之道之智是法无碍解。’‘如是应知’：‘如是’一词显示了知的次第。‘以此等方式’：‘如此’一词显示作为了知之因的理路。
entries.english: Harder to fully comprehend means harder to achieve or accomplish; that is, hard to penetrate due to the obstruction of faculties. The distinguishing of intrinsic characteristics is by means of the characteristics of oppression, origination, tranquility, and exit. Because of their depth, they are hard to delve into—suffering and its origin are coarse. For even in the case of animals, suffering and desire for food and so forth are evident, but because of their inability to fully grasp 'this is suffering, this is its cause' by way of affliction, accumulation, and so on, these truths are profound. Cessation and the path, due to their nature as subtle and refined phenomena, are hard to penetrate because they are profound by their very nature. For that very reason, when the path has arisen, there is no non-penetration of cessation and the path as they truly are. Nibbāna, being attainable by the path, is designated as its fruit; hence, it is said, 'by designation as fruit.' For it is said: 'Knowledge of the cessation of suffering is the analytical knowledge of meaning' (Vibh. 719). The path, too, being the cause for accomplishing cessation, is designated as the cause; hence, it is said, 'by designation as cause.' And this is also stated: 'Knowledge of the path leading to the cessation of suffering is the analytical knowledge of phenomena' (Vibh. 719). 'Thus one should understand'—with the word 'thus,' it shows the manner of understanding. 'By such means'—with the word 'such,' it refers to the methods that are the reasons for understanding.

entries.pali: 205 . Aññamaggapaṭikkhepanattha nti titthiyehi kappitassa maggassa dukkhanirodhagāminipaṭipadābhāvaṃ paṭikkhepetunti attho, aññassa vā maggabhāvapaṭikkhepo aññamaggapaṭikkhepo . Puggalassa ariyabhāvakarattā ariyaṃ karotīti ariyo, ariyaphalapaṭilābhakarattā ariyaṃ labhāpeti janetīti ariyo . Attano kiccavasena phalavasena ca ariyanāmalābho eva vuttoti daṭṭhabbo. Aṭṭha aṅgāni assāti aññapadatthasamāsaṃ akatvā ‘‘aṭṭhaṅgāni assa santīti aṭṭhaṅgiko’’ ti padasiddhi daṭṭhabbā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 205. “为遮止他道”的意思是，否定由外道所构想的道具有导向苦灭之道途的性质；或遮止他者之道性，即是“遮止他道”。能使人(puggala)成为圣者，故为“圣”；能令人获得圣果，故为“圣”。当知正是由于其作用与果，才获得了“圣”之名。不作“有八支分”这样的依主释，而应了知其构词为：“彼有八支分，故为八支”。
entries.english: 205. 'For the purpose of rejecting other paths' means to reject the path devised by sectarians on account of its not being the practice leading to the cessation of suffering; this is the meaning. Or, the rejection of another's state of being a path is the rejection of other paths. Because it makes a person noble, it is called noble (ariya); because it causes the attainment of noble fruits, it is called noble (ariya). It should be understood that the name 'noble' is thus obtained on account of its function and its fruit. The derivation of the word should be understood as follows: without forming a compound implying another word's meaning, the word `aṭṭhaṅgiko` is formed from the phrase 'possessing eight factors'.

entries.pali: 215 . Evaṃ purimesupi dvīsū ti kasmā vuttaṃ, nanu suttantabhājanīye dukkhanirodhagāminipaṭipadāniddese lokiyalokuttaramissako maggo vutto. Tassa hi aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (vibha. aṭṭha. 205) ‘‘catūsu saccesu uggahādivasena pubbabhāgañāṇuppattiṃ sandhāya idaṃ ‘dukkhe ñāṇa’ntiādi vuttaṃ, paṭivedhakkhaṇe pana ekameva ñāṇaṃ hotī’’ti sammādiṭṭhiyā, tathā sammāsaṅkappādīnañca lokiyalokuttaramissakatā dassitā ‘‘apicesā sammādiṭṭhi nāma pubbabhāge nānākkhaṇā nānārammaṇā hoti, maggakkhaṇe ekakkhaṇā ekārammaṇā’’tiādinā cāti? Saccametaṃ, evaṃ pana āgamanavasena tatthāpi catusaccakammaṭṭhānadassanādimukhena ariyova aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo dassito. Evañca katvā ‘‘paṭivedhakkhaṇe pana ekameva ñāṇaṃ hotī’’ti maggañāṇassa ekasseva dukkhañāṇāditā, ‘‘maggakkhaṇe pana…pe… ekova kusalasaṅkappo uppajjati, ayaṃ sammāsaṅkappo nāmā’’tiādinā maggasaṅkappādīnaṃ sammāsaṅkappāditā ca niddhāritā, pāḷiyañca aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ uddisitvā tameva niddisituṃ ‘‘dukkhe ñāṇa’’ntiādi vuttaṃ. Tena suttantabhājanīyepi dvinnaṃ lokiyatā, dvinnaṃ lokuttaratā vuttā ‘‘evaṃ purimesupi dvīsū ti etenāti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 215. 为何说‘如前二者亦然’？在经分别(Suttantabhājanīya)中，于导向苦灭之道的解释里，所说的道难道不是世间与出世间混合的吗？其义注中提到：‘这是针对在四圣谛中通过领会等方式令预备阶段的智生起而说“于苦之智”等；但在通达的刹那，只有一个智生起。’同样，对于正见，以及正思惟等，也开示了其世间与出世间的混合性，如说：‘再者，此正见，在预备阶段是多刹那、多所缘的；在道的刹那是单刹那、单所缘的’等。此言不虚。然而，依据传承，在那里也通过以四圣谛为业处进行观察等方式，只开示了圣八支道。这样一来，‘在通达的刹那只有一个智生起’确定了道智(maggañāṇa)即是苦智等；而‘在道的刹那……只有一个善思惟生起，这称为正思惟’等，则确定了道思惟等即是正思惟等；并且在巴利圣典中，先总说八支道，然后为了解释它，才说‘于苦之智’等。因此，在经分别中，说二者是世间的，二者是出世间的，是基于此而说‘如前二者亦然’。
entries.english: 215. Why is it said, 'Thus, in the previous two as well'? Is it not the case that in the Suttanta division, in the exposition of the path leading to the cessation of suffering, a path mixed with the mundane and supramundane is stated? For in its commentary (Vibhaṅga Aṭṭhakathā 205), it is said, 'With regard to the four truths, referring to the arising of knowledge in the preliminary stage by way of grasping, etc., this is called “knowledge of suffering,” etc., but at the moment of penetration, there is only one knowledge.' Similarly, the state of right view, and right intention, etc., being mixed with the mundane and supramundane is shown: 'Moreover, this right view, in the preliminary stage, has diverse moments and diverse objects, but at the path moment, it is single in moment and single in object,' and so on. This is true. However, according to the tradition, there too, the noble eightfold path is shown through the means of demonstrating the meditation subject of the four truths, and so on. And having done so, the state of the single path knowledge as the knowledge of suffering, etc., is determined by the statement, 'At the moment of penetration, however, there is only one knowledge.' And the state of the path-intentions and so on as right intention and so on is determined by the statement, 'At the path moment… only one wholesome intention arises—this is called right intention,' and so on. And in the Pāli, after stating the eightfold path in brief, 'knowledge of suffering,' and so on is stated to explain that very path in detail. Therefore, by this statement, 'thus, in the previous two as well,' it is said that in the Suttanta division also, the mundaneness of two and the supramundaneness of two are stated.

entries.pali: 52 . Tisso bhūmiyo imassāti tibhūmaṃ, tibhūmaṃyeva tebhūmakaṃ . Vattati ettha kammaṃ, tabbipāko cāti vaṭṭaṃ. Taṇhā ti kāmataṇhādivasena tividhā, puna chaḷārammaṇavasena aṭṭhārasavidhā, atītānāgatapaccuppannavasena catupaññāsavidhā, ajjhattikabāhiravasena aṭṭhasatappabhedā taṇhā. Kasmā pana aññesupi dukkhahetūsu santesu taṇhāyeva samudayoti vuttāti? Padhānakāraṇattā. Kammavicittatāhetubhāvena, hi kammasahāyabhāvūpagamanena ca dukkhavicittatākāraṇattā taṇhā dukkhassa visesakāraṇanti . Maggo dukkhanirodhagāminipaṭipadānāmena vutto maggo lokuttaro matoti maggoti puna maggaggahaṇaṃ yojetabbaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 52. 此有三地，故为三地，三地即三界。业及其异熟在此中运转，故为轮回。渴爱，以欲爱等分为三种；复以六所缘分为十八种；以过去、未来、现在分为五十四种；以内、外分为一百零八种。然则，于其他苦因存在时，为何唯说渴爱为集？因其为主要原因。因为渴爱是业种种差别之因，且以助成业而成为苦种种差别之因，故渴爱是苦的特殊原因。道，以‘导向苦灭之行道’之名而说，此道被认为是出世间的，因此，应结合此义再次理解‘道’谛。
entries.english: 52. It has three planes, hence it is 'of three planes' (tibhūma); that which is 'of three planes' is indeed 'belonging to the three planes' (tebhūmaka). Herein kamma operates, and its result; this is the round (vaṭṭa). Craving (taṇhā) is threefold by way of sensual craving, etc.; again, eighteenfold by way of the six objects; fifty-fourfold by way of past, future, and present; and one hundred and eightfold by way of internal and external. But why, when there are other causes of suffering, is craving alone declared as the origin? Because it is the principal cause. For due to its being the cause of the diversity of kamma, its becoming a companion to kamma, and its being the cause of the diversity of suffering, craving is a specific cause of suffering. The path (maggo), spoken of by the name 'the practice leading to the cessation of suffering,' is understood as the supramundane path; thus, the term 'path' (maggo) should be connected again.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门古复注 Abhidhammāvatāra-Purāṇaṭīkā
entries.pali: Evaṃ yuttivasena vibhāvitaṃ ekapaṭivedhaṃ āgamenapi sādhetuṃ ‘‘vuttampi ceta’’ ntiādi vuttaṃ. Maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇa nti hi ‘‘yo nu kho, āvuso, dukkhaṃ passati, dukkhasamudayampi so passati, dukkhanirodhampi, dukkhanirodhagāminipaṭipadampi so passatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.1100) ekasaccadassanasamaṅgino aññasaccadassanasamaṅgibhāvavicāraṇāyaṃ tamatthaṃ sādhetuṃ āyasmatā gavampatittherena vuttaṃ. Aññathā kamābhisamaye sati purimadiṭṭhassa puna adassanato samudayādipassato dukkhādidassanaṃ puna avattabbaṃ siyā. Idāni panettha upamāsaṃsandanaṃ karonto āha ‘‘padīpo’’ tiādi. Nissayābhāvahetutāya dukkhapariññāya vaṭṭijjhāpanasadisatā, paṭipakkhaviddhaṃsanatāya samudayappahānassa andhakāravināsanasadisatā, ñāṇālokaparibrūhanatāya maggabhāvanāya ālokavidaṃsanasadisatā, tena tena maggena yathā yathā nirodhassa sacchikiriyā, tathā tathā kilesasnehapariyādānaṃ hotīti nirodhasacchikiriyāya snehapariyādānasadisatā kāraṇūpacārena vuttā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 如此依相应之理阐明一谛现观时，为以圣典证明，故说“亦曾如是说”等。所谓具道者之智，诚如“贤友，若见苦，则亦见苦集、苦灭、以及导向苦灭之道”（《相应部》5.1100），此乃具寿伽梵波帝(Gavampati)长老为阐明见一谛者亦见其余诸谛之义而说。否则，若为次第现观，则先前所见者不再被见，故于见集等时，不应再言见苦等。现在，为连接譬喻，故说“灯”等。由于（遍知苦）能令（渴爱）无所依止，故苦之遍知犹如灯芯烧尽；由于能摧毁对立法，故集之断除犹如驱散黑暗；由于能增长智光，故道之修习犹如光明显现；以彼彼道，如如证得灭，如是如是烦恼之油亦被耗尽，故证灭犹如油尽，此乃以因作喻之说。
entries.english: In order to establish by scripture as well this single penetration that has been explained by way of reasoning, the passage beginning 'And this was said...' was stated. For this was said by the Venerable Gavampati Thera to establish the meaning in the context of investigating how one endowed with the vision of one truth is endowed with the vision of the other truths: 'The knowledge of one endowed with the path is this: “Friend, one who sees suffering also sees the origin of suffering, the cessation of suffering, and the path leading to the cessation of suffering”' (SN 56.30). Otherwise, if there were a sequential comprehension, since what was seen before would not be seen again, it would not be necessary to state again the seeing of suffering and so on for one who sees the origin and so on. Now, making a connection with the simile here, he says: 'A lamp...' and so on. The full understanding of suffering is like the burning up of the wick because it is the cause for the absence of a support; the abandoning of the origin is like the destruction of darkness because it destroys the opponent; the development of the path is like the illuminating of light because it augments the light of knowledge; because the exhaustion of the 'oil' of the defilements occurs in whatever way the realization of cessation occurs by means of each path, the realization of cessation is said to be like the exhaustion of the oil by a metaphor based on the cause.

entries.pali: Nibbānābyākataṃ pana bhūmito lokuttarameva, dhammatopi ca ekameva, bhedo natthi, lakkhaṇādito pana santilakkhaṇaṃ nibbānaṃ, nivattilakkhaṇaṃ, asaṅkhatalakkhaṇaṃ vā, accutirasaṃ , animittapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ, asaṅkhatatāya panassa kārakahetuvirahato padaṭṭhānaṃ natthi, pāpakahetuvasena panetaṃ ‘‘dukkhanirodhagāminipaṭipadā’’tiādivacanato (vibha. 206) ‘‘ariyamaggapadaṭṭhāna’’nti vattuṃ vaṭṭati. Saṅgahato pana bhedābhāvā khandhesu saṅgahaṃ na gacchati, āyatanādīsu dhammāyatanadhammadhātūsu saṅgahaṃ gacchati. Suññato pana attasuññaṃ, salakkhaṇadhāraṇato anattakaṃ dhammamattaṃ, asaṅkhatatāya vā accantattā ca aniccatāsuññaṃ, dukkhatāsuññaṃ, rāgādisuññaṃ, nimittasuññanti pavattaṃ suññanti gahetabbaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 就涅槃无记而言，从界地来说，唯是出世间法。就法性而言，亦是唯一，没有差别。从相而言，涅槃为寂静相、止息相或无为相；其作用为不死；其现起为无相。又因其无为性，没有造作因，故无近因。但从能达之因而言，根据‘导向苦灭之道’等语(《分别论》206)，可以说‘以圣道为近因’。从摄集而言，由于没有差别，它不被摄入诸蕴中，但在诸处、界中，它被摄入法处和法界。从空性而言，它是无我空，因为它持有自相，故仅是无我之法；或者由于其无为性与究竟性，它是空无无常、空无苦、空无贪等、空无诸相。应知其为空无流转。
entries.english: The Indeterminate Nibbāna, however, from the standpoint of plane, is simply supramundane. And also by way of nature, it is just one; there is no division. From the perspective of characteristics, Nibbāna has the characteristic of peace, the characteristic of cessation, or the characteristic of being unconditioned. Its essence is immutability, and its manifestation is signless. Due to its unconditioned nature, it has no proximate cause, as it is devoid of a productive cause. However, by way of the cause for its attainment, it is proper to say that it has the Noble Path as its proximate cause, as stated in phrases like 'the path leading to the cessation of suffering' (Vibhaṅga 206). In terms of inclusion, since Nibbāna has no divisions, it is not included among the aggregates. It is, however, included among the sense-spheres and elements, specifically in the mental-object sense-sphere and the mental-object element. From the perspective of emptiness, Nibbāna is empty of self. By maintaining its own characteristic, it is merely a phenomenon that is without self. Due to its unconditioned nature and its being ultimate, it should be understood that it is empty of impermanence, empty of suffering, empty of defilements like greed, and empty of signs, and that it is empty of what is conditioned.
